title: narrative tenses review
rule_uz: Voqea hikoya qilganda to'rt zamonni birga ishlatamiz. Past Simple asosiy voqealarni ketma-ket aytadi: we arrived, we ate. Past Continuous fon va davom etayotgan ishni ko'rsatadi: it was raining. Past Perfect boshqa voqeadan oldin bo'lgan ishni bildiradi: had left. Past Perfect Continuous esa o'sha oldingi ishning qancha davom etganini ta'kidlaydi: had been walking.
forms: Past Simple: arrived, opened, saw
Past Continuous: was / were + verb-ing
Past Perfect: had + past participle
Past Perfect Continuous: had been + verb-ing

title: present perfect vs past simple (finished vs unfinished time)
rule_uz: Tugagan, aniq vaqtda bo'lgan ishni Past Simple bilan aytamiz: yesterday, last year, in 2020. Hali davom etayotgan davr yoki hozirga aloqador natija uchun Present Perfect ishlatamiz: today, this week, ever, already, just. Present Perfect aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan ishlatilmaydi. Savol "qachon?" bo'lsa, odatda Past Simple kerak. Present Perfect: have / has + past participle.
forms: finished time: Past Simple (yesterday, last week, in 2019)
unfinished time: have / has + past participle (this week, so far)
ever / never / already / yet / just + Present Perfect
When ...? -> Past Simple

title: present perfect continuous: duration and results
rule_uz: Present Perfect Continuous ishning qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini yoki hozirgina tugaganini va izi ko'rinib turganini aytadi. Shakli: have / has been + fe'l-ing. For (muddat) va since (boshlanish vaqti) bilan ko'p ishlatiladi. Natija yoki son-miqdorga e'tibor bersak, Present Perfect Simple ishlatamiz: I have written five emails. Stative fe'llar (know, like) odatda continuous bo'lmaydi.

for two hours / since 9 o'clock / all day

title: past perfect continuous
rule_uz: Past Perfect Continuous o'tgan paytdan oldin qancha davom etgan ishni ko'rsatadi. Shakli: had been + fe'l-ing. U ko'pincha sabab yoki natijani tushuntiradi: u charchagan edi, chunki uzoq yugurgan edi. For va since bilan ishlatiladi. Ish bir marta tugagan bo'lsa yoki son bo'lsa, Past Perfect Simple yaxshiroq. Stative fe'llar bilan ishlatilmaydi.

had not (hadn't) been + working

for / since + past time point

title: used to / would / be used to / get used to
title_uz: Used to, would, be used to
rule_uz: Used to + fe'l o'tmishdagi odat yoki holatni bildiradi, hozir esa yo'q. Would + fe'l faqat takrorlanuvchi harakatlar uchun, holat uchun emas. Be used to + ism yoki -ing "ko'nikkan bo'lmoq" degani. Get used to + -ing esa "ko'nikib qolmoq" jarayonini bildiradi. Olmoshdan keyin to predlog bo'lgani uchun -ing keladi.
forms: used to + verb (past habit / state)
would + verb (repeated past action only)
be used to + noun / verb-ing
get used to + noun / verb-ing

title: future perfect
rule_uz: Future Perfect kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtgacha tugab bo'lgan ishni bildiradi. Shakli: will have + past participle. By (gacha), by the time, by next year kabi so'zlar bilan ishlatiladi. Inkor: won't have finished. Savol: Will you have finished...? By the time dan keyin kelasi zamon emas, Present Simple keladi.

will not (won't) have + past participle
Will + subject + have + past participle?
by tomorrow / by 2030 / by the time + Present Simple

title: future continuous

Shuningdek, rejalashtirilgan ishlar haqida muloyim so'rashda ishlatiladi: Will you be using the computer? Stative fe'llar (know, want) bilan ishlatilmaydi.

will not (won't) be + verb-ing

title: future in the past (was going to, would)
rule_uz: O'tmishda turib, o'sha paytdagi kelajak haqida gapirganda was / were going to va would ishlatamiz. Was going to reja yoki niyatni bildiradi, ko'pincha u amalga oshmagan bo'ladi: I was going to call you, but I forgot. Would hikoyada keyin nima bo'lganini aytadi: He said he would help. Was about to esa "hozir qilmoqchi edi" degani.
forms: was / were going to + verb (past plan)
would + verb (future seen from the past)
was / were about to + verb
I thought / said / knew + would

arrangement: am / is / are + verb-ing

title: time clauses with future meaning
rule_uz: When, as soon as, before, after, until, by the time kabi so'zlardan keyin kelajak haqida gapirsak ham will ishlatmaymiz. Payt gapida Present Simple yoki tugallanganlikni ko'rsatish uchun Present Perfect ishlatiladi. Asosiy gapda esa will keladi: I will call you when I arrive. Present Perfect ishning tugab bo'lganini ta'kidlaydi: after I have finished.
forms: When / as soon as + Present Simple, ... will + verb
before / until / after + Present Simple
after / as soon as + Present Perfect (finished action)
not: when I will arrive

title: zero and first conditionals (unless, as long as, provided that)
rule_uz: Zero conditional doim to'g'ri bo'lgan haqiqatlarni aytadi: If you heat ice, it melts. If qismida ham, natija qismida ham Present Simple. First conditional kelajakdagi real imkoniyat uchun: If + Present Simple, will + verb. Unless "agar ... bo'lmasa" degani (if ... not). As long as va provided that "faqat shu shart bilan" ma'nosini beradi. If dan keyin will kelmaydi.
forms: Zero: If + Present Simple, Present Simple
First: If + Present Simple, will + verb
unless = if ... not
as long as / provided that + Present Simple

title: second conditional (If I were ...)
rule_uz: Second conditional hozir yoki kelajakda ehtimoli kam yoki xayoliy vaziyatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Shakli: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l. Xayoliy gapda I, he, she, it bilan ko'pincha were ishlatiladi: If I were you. Maslahat berishda If I were you, I would ... deymiz. If qismida would ishlatilmaydi.

If I were you, I would ...

title: third conditional
rule_uz: Third conditional o'tmishda bo'lmagan narsa haqida, "agar shunday bo'lganida ..." deb afsuslanishda ishlatiladi. Shakli: If + Past Perfect, would have + past participle. Bu o'tmishni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun u xayoliy. Would have o'rniga could have yoki might have ham kelishi mumkin. If qismida would have kelmaydi.

If I hadn't forgotten ..., I would have ...
could have / might have + past participle

title: mixed conditionals
rule_uz: Mixed conditional ikki vaqtni aralashtiradi. Birinchi tur: o'tmishdagi sabab, hozirgi natija. If + Past Perfect, would + fe'l: If I had studied, I would have a better job now. Ikkinchi tur: hozirgi yoki doimiy holat, o'tmishdagi natija. If + Past Simple, would have + V3: If I were braver, I would have spoken. Gapda now, today kabi so'zlar vaqtni aniqlashga yordam beradi.

If + Past Simple, would have + V3 (present state -> past result)

title: wish / if only (present and past)
rule_uz: Wish va if only bilan hozirgi vaziyatdan norozilik bildiramiz: wish + Past Simple (I wish I had a bike). O'tmishdagi pushaymonlik uchun wish + Past Perfect: I wish I had studied. Hozirgi holatda "were" ishlatamiz: I wish I were taller. Boshqa odamning odatidan shikoyat qilsak, wish + would: I wish he would stop. If only xuddi shunday, lekin kuchliroq.
forms: wish / if only + Past Simple (present regret)
wish / if only + Past Perfect (past regret)
wish + would (annoying habit / future change)
I wish I were ...

title: conditionals: in case, otherwise, or else
rule_uz: In case "ehtiyot bo'lib, bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holat uchun" degani. Undan keyin Present Simple (kelajak uchun) yoki Past Simple (o'tmish uchun) keladi, will emas. Otherwise va or else "aks holda" degani: Hurry up, otherwise you will be late. Ular bitta gapda ham, ikki gap orasida ham ishlatiladi. In case if bilan bir xil emas: in case oldindan tayyorgarlikni bildiradi.
forms: in case + Present Simple (future precaution)
in case + Past Simple (past precaution)
..., otherwise + will / would
..., or else + will

title: passive: all tenses review
rule_uz: Majhul nisbatda ishni kim qilgani emas, ishning o'zi muhim. Shakli: to be + past participle. To be fe'li zamonni ko'rsatadi: is made, was made, has been made, will be made, is being made, had been made. Ishni bajaruvchini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa by ishlatamiz. Faqat obyektli (transitive) fe'llar majhul bo'ladi.
forms: Present Simple: is / are + V3
Past Simple: was / were + V3
Present Perfect: has / have been + V3
Continuous: is / was being + V3; Future: will be + V3

title: passive with get; impersonal passive (It is said that ...)
rule_uz: Og'zaki nutqda be o'rniga get ishlatish mumkin, ayniqsa kutilmagan hodisalarda: He got hurt. Shaxssiz majhulda ko'pchilik aytadigan fikr haqida gapiramiz: It is said that ... yoki People say -> He is said to be ... Bu shakl yangiliklarda va ma'ruzalarda ko'p uchraydi. Fe'llar: say, believe, think, know, report, expect. Kelasi struktura: subject + is said + to-infinitive.
forms: get + past participle (informal)
It is said / believed / thought that + clause
Subject + is said / believed to + verb
is known / expected / reported to + verb

title: passive infinitive and gerund
rule_uz: Majhul infinitiv: to be + V3. U to talab qiladigan fe'llar va modal fe'llardan keyin ishlatiladi: The room needs to be cleaned. Majhul gerund: being + V3. Prepozitsiyadan keyin yoki enjoy, avoid, like kabi fe'llardan keyin keladi: I don't like being told what to do. Ish bizga qilinsa majhul kerak, o'zimiz qilsak oddiy shakl.
forms: to be + past participle (passive infinitive)
being + past participle (passive gerund)
want / need / hope + to be + V3
enjoy / avoid / like + being + V3

title: causative: have / get something done
rule_uz: Biz ishni o'zimiz qilmay, boshqa odam qilsa, have something done ishlatamiz: I had my hair cut. Shakli: have / get + obyekt + past participle. Get ko'proq og'zaki nutq uchun. Zamon have yoki get fe'lida ko'rinadi: I am having my room painted. Kim qilishini aytish shart emas, kerak bo'lsa by ... bilan aytamiz.
forms: have + object + past participle
get + object + past participle (informal)
Present: I have my car washed.
Past: She had her phone repaired.

examples.en: We had our house painted last summer.

mistakes.note_uz: Boshqa kishi qilgan ish uchun have + V3.

mistakes.note_uz: Obyektdan keyin V3 keladi.

title: reported speech: backshift of tenses
rule_uz: Birovning gapini boshqa odamga yetkazganda ko'pincha zamonni bir pog'ona orqaga suramiz. Present Simple -> Past Simple, Present Continuous -> Past Continuous, Present Perfect -> Past Perfect, Past Simple -> Past Perfect, will -> would, can -> could. Olmoshlar va vaqt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi: now -> then, today -> that day, tomorrow -> the next day. Said dan keyin that ishlatish shart emas.
forms: am / is -> was; are -> were
play -> played; played -> had played
will -> would; can -> could
now -> then; tomorrow -> the next day

examples.en: Ali said, "I am hungry." -> Ali said he was hungry.
examples.uz: Ali "Men ochman" dedi. -> Ali och ekanini aytdi.

examples.en: She said, "I have finished." -> She said she had finished.
examples.uz: U "Men tugatdim" dedi. -> U tugatganini aytdi.

examples.en: Tom said, "I will help you." -> Tom said he would help me.
examples.uz: Tom "Men senga yordam beraman" dedi. -> Tom menga yordam berishini aytdi.

mistakes.wrong: He said he is tired.
mistakes.right: He said he was tired.
mistakes.note_uz: Said dan keyin zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.

mistakes.wrong: She said me that she was busy.
mistakes.right: She told me that she was busy.
mistakes.note_uz: Say dan keyin shaxs kelmaydi, tell ishlatiladi.

title: reported questions and orders
rule_uz: Ko'chirma savolda so'roq gap tartibi oddiy gap tartibiga o'tadi: ega oldin, fe'l keyin. Do / does / did ishlatilmaydi va so'roq belgisi qo'yilmaydi. Wh- so'rog'i bor savolda o'sha so'z qoladi: He asked where I lived. Ha/yo'q savolda if yoki whether ishlatiladi. Buyruq uchun told / asked + shaxs + to + fe'l: She told me to sit down. Inkorda not to.
forms: asked + wh-word + subject + verb (backshifted)
asked + if / whether + subject + verb
told / asked + person + to + verb
told + person + not to + verb

examples.en: "Where do you live?" -> He asked me where I lived.
examples.uz: "Qayerda yashaysan?" -> U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.

mistakes.note_uz: Ko'chirma savolda oddiy gap tartibi bo'ladi.

mistakes.wrong: He told me don't touch it.
mistakes.right: He told me not to touch it.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkor buyruq: told + shaxs + not to + fe'l.

title: reporting verbs (suggest, admit, promise, refuse, warn)
rule_uz: Say va tell o'rniga aniqroq fe'llar ishlatamiz. Promise, refuse, offer, agree + to + fe'l: She promised to call. Admit, deny, suggest + -ing: He admitted breaking the vase. Suggest + that + gap ham mumkin: I suggested that we go. Warn, remind, advise + shaxs + to + fe'l: Mum warned me not to touch it. Each verbning o'z qolipi bor, ularni yodlab oling.
forms: promise / refuse / agree / offer + to + verb
admit / deny / suggest + verb-ing
warn / remind / advise + person + (not) to + verb
apologise for + verb-ing

examples.en: The guide warned us not to feed the animals.
examples.uz: Gid bizni hayvonlarni boqmaslikka ogohlantirdi.

title: deduction in the past: must have, can't have, might have
rule_uz: O'tmishda nima bo'lganini mavjud dalillar asosida taxmin qilamiz. Must have + V3 deyarli aniq narsa uchun ("bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak"). Can't have / couldn't have + V3 mumkin emasligini bildiradi. Might have / may have / could have + V3 esa ehtimolni, ya'ni "bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin" degani. Hozirgi taxmin uchun must be, can't be ishlatiladi.
forms: must have + past participle (almost sure)
can't / couldn't have + past participle (impossible)
might / may / could have + past participle (possible)
present: must be / can't be / might be

examples.uz: U meni ko'rgan bo'lishi mumkin emas. U boshqa shaharda edi.

examples.uz: U sumkasini avtobusda qoldirgan bo'lishi mumkin.

mistakes.note_uz: O'tmish taxmini uchun can't have + V3.

title: obligation and advice in the past: had to, should have
rule_uz: Had to o'tmishdagi majburiyatni bildiradi va u amalga oshgan: I had to wear a uniform. Didn't have to: majburiy emas edi. Should have / ought to have + V3 esa o'tmishda qilish kerak edi, lekin qilinmadi, degan afsus yoki tanqid: You should have called. Shouldn't have + V3 - qilmaslik kerak edi, lekin qilindi. Must o'tmishda ishlatilmaydi, had to ishlatiladi.
forms: had to + verb (past obligation)
didn't have to + verb (it wasn't necessary)
should / ought to have + past participle
shouldn't have + past participle

title: permission and ability in the past
rule_uz: O'tgan zamondagi umumiy qobiliyat haqida could ishlatamiz: I could swim when I was five. Bir marta, aniq bir vaqtda uddalagan ishimiz haqida was/were able to yoki managed to ishlatamiz. Bunday holatda ijobiy gapda could ishlatilmaydi. Inkor gapda couldn't ikkala holatda ham to'g'ri keladi. Ruxsat haqida was/were allowed to yoki could ishlatamiz: We were allowed to use phones at the trip.
forms: could + verb (umumiy qobiliyat)
was / were able to + verb (bir martalik)
managed to + verb
was / were allowed to + verb (ruxsat)

title: need / needn't / don't need to; needn't have
rule_uz: Kerak bo'lgan narsa haqida need to ishlatamiz: I need to study. Kerak emas deyish uchun don't need to yoki needn't (+ fe'l, to siz) ishlatiladi: You needn't hurry. O'tgan zamonda didn't need to ishi kerak bo'lmaganini bildiradi, qilganmi yoki yo'qmi noma'lum. Needn't have + V3 esa ish keraksiz bo'lsa ham qilib bo'lingan ekanini bildiradi: I needn't have taken an umbrella - it didn't rain.
forms: need to + verb
don't / doesn't need to + verb
needn't + verb (to siz)
didn't need to + verb
needn't have + V3

title: would for habits; polite requests (Would you mind ...)
rule_uz: O'tmishdagi takrorlanuvchi odatlar haqida would + fe'l ishlatamiz: Every summer we would visit our grandparents. Would holat fe'llari (be, have, know, like) bilan ishlatilmaydi, ularda used to kerak. Xushmuomala iltimos uchun Would you mind + fe'l-ing ...? deymiz: Would you mind opening the window? Rozilik bildirish uchun Not at all yoki Of course not deymiz. Ruxsat so'rashda Would you mind if I + o'tgan zamon ...? ishlatiladi.
forms: would + verb (o'tmishdagi odat)
Would you mind + V-ing ...?
Would you mind if I + V2 ...?
Not at all. / No, of course not.

title: gerund vs infinitive 1: verbs followed by either
title_uz: Gerund va infinitiv 1: ikkalasi ham keladigan fe'llar
rule_uz: Like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin va continue fe'llaridan keyin -ing ham, to + fe'l ham kelishi mumkin, ma'no deyarli o'zgarmaydi: I like swimming = I like to swim. Start va begin o'zi -ing shaklida bo'lsa, ikkita -ing ketma-ket kelmasligi uchun infinitiv ishlatiladi: It is starting to rain. Would like, would love va would prefer dan keyin faqat to + fe'l keladi: I would like to go.
forms: like / love / hate / prefer + V-ing yoki to + V
start / begin / continue + V-ing yoki to + V
would like / would love / would prefer + to + V
was starting / beginning + to + V

title: gerund vs infinitive 2: change of meaning (remember, regret, try, stop, go on)
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing yoki to + fe'l kelsa, ma'no o'zgaradi. Remember to do - qilishni esda tutish; remember doing - qilganini eslash. Stop doing - qilishni to'xtatish; stop to do - boshqa ish uchun to'xtash. Try to do - urinish; try doing - sinab ko'rish. Regret to say - afsus bilan xabar berish; regret doing - qilganimdan afsuslanish. Go on doing - davom etish; go on to do - keyin boshqa ishga o'tish.
forms: remember / forget + to do (vazifa) | + doing (o'tmish)
stop + doing (to'xtatish) | stop + to do (maqsad)
try + to do (urinish) | try + doing (sinab ko'rish)
regret + doing | regret + to say / tell
go on + doing | go on + to do

title: verb + object + infinitive (want, ask, tell, allow)
rule_uz: Want, ask, tell, allow, advise, invite, expect, would like kabi fe'llardan keyin ko'pincha shaxs (to'ldiruvchi) va to + fe'l keladi: My mum wants me to study. Tartibi: fe'l + shaxs + to + fe'l. Inkor shaklda to dan oldin not qo'yiladi: She told us not to run. Make va let dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi: He made me laugh. Want va would like dan keyin that bilan gap tuzish mumkin emas: I want that you come noto'g'ri.
forms: want / expect / would like + object + to + verb
ask / tell / advise / allow + object + to + verb
tell / ask + object + not to + verb
make / let + object + verb (to siz)

mistakes.right: She made me clean my room.

title: -ing after prepositions; verb + preposition + -ing
rule_uz: Predloglardan keyin fe'l har doim -ing shaklida keladi: She is good at drawing. Before, after, without, instead of, by, for kabi so'zlardan keyin ham shunday. Ko'p fe'llar predlog bilan keladi va keyin -ing talab qiladi: look forward to, insist on, apologise for, think of, succeed in. Diqqat: look forward to dagi to bu predlog, shuning uchun look forward to meeting deymiz. Qo'shimcha: by + -ing ish qanday bajarilganini bildiradi.
forms: preposition + V-ing
be good at / be interested in / be afraid of + V-ing
look forward to / insist on / apologise for + V-ing
by + V-ing (usul)

title: relative clauses: defining and non-defining
title_uz: Aniqlovchi va qo'shimcha izohli ergash gaplar
rule_uz: Defining clause kimligini yoki qaysi ekanini aniqlaydi va vergulsiz yoziladi: The boy who lives next door is my friend. Unda who/which o'rniga that ishlatish mumkin va to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, o'zini tushirib qoldirish mumkin. Non-defining clause qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi, vergul bilan ajratiladi: My brother, who lives in Samarkand, is a chef. Unda that ishlatilmaydi va who/which tushirib qoldirilmaydi. Which butun gap haqida ham izoh berishi mumkin.
forms: defining: noun + who / which / that + verb (vergulsiz)
defining: noun + (that) + subject + verb
non-defining: noun, + who / which + ..., (vergul bilan)
non-defining: that ishlatilmaydi

title: relative clauses with prepositions; reduced relative clauses
rule_uz: Predlog relative clause oxirida ham, who/which dan oldin ham kelishi mumkin: The girl I talked to / The girl to whom I talked. Rasmiy uslubda predlog which/whom dan oldin turadi va that ishlatilmaydi. Qisqartirilgan clause'da who/which + is/are tushiriladi: The boy sitting there is my brother (= who is sitting). O'tgan zamon majhul shaklida V3 ishlatiladi: The cake made by Mum is delicious. Fe'l-ing faol ma'noda, V3 majhul ma'noda.
forms: noun + (that) + subject + verb + preposition
preposition + which / whom (rasmiy)
noun + V-ing (= who / which + is + V-ing)
noun + V3 (= which / that + is / was + V3)

title: articles (advanced)
rule_uz: A/an birinchi marta aytilgan yoki noaniq narsa uchun, the esa ikkala tomonga ma'lum yoki yagona narsa uchun ishlatiladi: the sun, the best student. Umumiy ma'noda ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan artikl ishlatilmaydi: Dogs are friendly. The + sifat bilan butun guruhni bildiradi: the rich, the young. Odatda artiklsiz: tillar, ko'pchilik mamlakatlar, ovqat nomlari (have lunch), go to school/bed. The ishlatiladi: daryolar, okeanlar, tog' tizmalari (the Alps), the UK, the USA.
forms: a / an + birinchi marta aytilgan yoki noaniq ot
the + ma'lum yoki yagona narsa (the moon, the best)
artiklsiz: umumiy ko'plik / sanalmaydigan otlar
the + daryo / okean / tog' tizmasi; the + sifat (the elderly)

title: quantifiers: much / many / few / little / plenty of / a number of
title_uz: Miqdor so'zlari: much, many, few, little ...
rule_uz: Many va few sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan, much va little sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi. A few va a little ijobiy ma'no beradi (bir oz bor), few va little esa deyarli yo'q degani. Much asosan inkor va savol gaplarda, ijobiy gapda a lot of afzal. Plenty of - yetarli va ko'p, ikkala turdagi otlar bilan. A number of + ko'plik ot (bir qancha); the number of + ko'plik ot, fe'l birlikda.
forms: many / few / a few + sanaladigan ko'plik ot
much / little / a little + sanalmaydigan ot
a lot of / plenty of + ikkala tur
a number of + ko'plik ot

examples.uz: Chet elda yashaydigan bir nechta do'stim bor.

title: determiners: each / every / all / whole / both / either / neither
title_uz: Aniqlovchilar: each, every, all, whole, both, either, neither
rule_uz: Each va every birlikdagi ot va birlik fe'l bilan keladi: Every student has a book. Each ayrim-ayrim olingan shaxsni bildiradi. All va both ko'plik bilan ishlatiladi: all the children, both parents. Whole birlikdagi otdan oldin the dan keyin keladi: the whole day. Either - ikkitadan biri, neither - ikkalasi ham emas, ikkalasidan keyin ham birlik fe'l keladi. Neither o'zi inkor, shuning uchun fe'l ijobiy shaklda bo'ladi.
forms: each / every + birlik ot + birlik fe'l
all / both + (the) + ko'plik ot
the whole + birlik ot
either / neither + birlik ot (ikkitadan)

title: comparison (advanced): twice as, far / much more, the + comparative
rule_uz: Kuchli farqni far, much, a lot bilan bildiramiz: far more expensive, much taller. Kichik farq uchun slightly, a bit, a little ishlatiladi. Karrali taqqoslash: twice as ... as, three times as ... as, half as ... as. The + qiyosiy daraja, the + qiyosiy daraja tuzilishi bir narsa o'zgarsa, ikkinchisi ham o'zgarishini bildiradi: The more you practise, the better you play. As ... as va not as ... as ham keng ishlatiladi.
forms: far / much / a lot + comparative + than
a bit / slightly + comparative + than
twice / three times / half + as + adj + as
the + comparative, the + comparative

title: adjective order; gradable and ungradable adjectives
title_uz: Sifatlar tartibi; darajalanadigan va darajalanmaydigan sifatlar
rule_uz: Bir necha sifat ketma-ket kelsa, odatda tartib shunday: fikr, o'lcham, yosh, shakl, rang, kelib chiqish, material, so'ngra ot: a lovely small old round red Turkish wooden box. Amalda ikki-uch sifatdan ortiq ishlatilmaydi. Darajalanadigan sifatlar (cold, tired, big) very, quite, extremely bilan keladi. Ekstremal yoki mutlaq sifatlar (freezing, exhausted, huge, perfect) very bilan kelmaydi, ular bilan absolutely, completely, really ishlatiladi.
forms: fikr + o'lcham + yosh + rang + kelib chiqish + material + ot
a beautiful old wooden house
gradable: very / quite / extremely + cold, tired
ungradable: absolutely / completely + freezing, exhausted

title: adverb position (already, still, yet, even, only)
rule_uz: Already odatda fe'l oldida yoki yordamchi fe'ldan keyin turadi: I have already finished. Gap oxirida ham keladi va hayrat bildiradi. Yet inkor va savol gaplarda gap oxirida keladi: I haven't finished yet. Still inkor gapda yordamchi fe'ldan oldin turadi: I still haven't finished, ijobiy gapda esa fe'l oldida: She still lives here. Even va only o'zi ta'kidlayotgan so'zdan oldin qo'yiladi, o'rni gap ma'nosini o'zgartiradi.
forms: subject + already + verb / have + already + V3
haven't + V3 + yet (gap oxirida)
subject + still + verb / still + haven't + V3
only / even + ta'kidlanayotgan so'z

title: adverbs of degree and focus
rule_uz: Degree ravishlari sifat yoki ravishning darajasini bildiradi: very, quite, rather, fairly, extremely, a bit. Quite va rather o'rtacha-kuchli, fairly sal kuchsizroq; rather ko'pincha salbiy tuyg'u beradi. Focus ravishlari (only, just, even, also, especially, mainly) gapdagi muhim so'zga e'tibor qaratadi va ular ta'kidlayotgan so'zdan oldin turadi. Quite a/an: quite a long film. Enough sifatdan keyin keladi.
forms: very / extremely / fairly / rather + sifat
quite a / an + sifat + ot
only / just / even + ta'kidlangan so'z
especially / mainly + so'z yoki ibora

title: so / such; too / enough; so that
title_uz: So / such; too / enough; so that
rule_uz: So + sifat yoki ravish: so tired. Such + (a/an) + (sifat) + ot: such a tired boy, such nice people. Natijani bildirish uchun so/such ... that ishlatiladi: It was so hot that we stayed inside. Too + sifat salbiy natija beradi (kerakdan ortiq): too heavy to carry. Sifat + enough + to + fe'l (yetarli): strong enough to lift. So that maqsadni bildiradi: I study so that I can pass the exam.

such + (a / an) + (sifat) + ot (+ that)
too + sifat (+ to + fe'l)
sifat + enough (+ to + fe'l); so that + can / could

title: contrast: although, even though, whereas, in spite of
title_uz: Zidlik: although, even though, whereas, in spite of
rule_uz: Although va even though (even though kuchliroq) dan keyin to'liq gap keladi: Although it was raining, we played outside. In spite of va despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: in spite of the rain, despite being tired. Whereas va while ikki narsani qarama-qarshi qo'yadi: My sister loves tea, whereas I prefer juice. But va however ham zidlikni bildiradi. Although bilan but birga ishlatilmaydi.
forms: although / even though + subject + verb
in spite of / despite + ot yoki V-ing
in spite of the fact that + gap
whereas / while + gap (qarama-qarshilik)

title: addition and result: moreover, therefore, as a result
title_uz: Qo'shimcha va natija: moreover, therefore, as a result
rule_uz: Fikrga qo'shimcha qilish uchun moreover, in addition, besides, also, as well as ishlatiladi: bular odatda yozma nutqda keladi. Natija uchun therefore, so, as a result, consequently, that's why ishlatiladi. Moreover, therefore, as a result kabi bog'lovchi so'zlar odatda gap boshida turadi va ulardan keyin vergul qo'yiladi. Oldingi gap nuqta bilan tugaydi yoki nuqtali vergul qo'yiladi. As well as dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi.
forms: Gap. Moreover, / In addition, / Besides, + gap
Gap. Therefore, / As a result, / Consequently, + gap
as well as + ot / V-ing
gap, so + natija

title: reason and purpose linkers
rule_uz: Sabab uchun because (gap bilan), because of va due to (ot bilan), as va since (sababi ma'lum bo'lganda) ishlatiladi. For dan keyin to + fe'l kelmaydi: I went to the shop to buy milk.

title: time clauses (as soon as, once, by the time)

rule_uz: As soon as va once ish tugashi bilan boshqa ish boshlanishini bildiradi. By the time - ... vaqtigacha, ya'ni oldin boshqa ish tugagan bo'ladi. title: short answers and ellipsis (So do I / Neither do I)
title_uz: Qisqa javoblar va so'z tushirib qoldirish
rule_uz: Ijobiy gapga roziligimizni So + yordamchi fe'l + ega bilan bildiramiz: I like pizza. - So do I. Inkor gapga Neither/Nor + yordamchi fe'l + ega: I don't like fish. - Neither do I. Yordamchi fe'l oldingi gapdagi zamonga mos bo'lishi kerak. Zidlik uchun I do / I don't deymiz: I love maths. - I don't. Ellipsis - takrorlanuvchi so'zlarni tushirib qoldirish: She can swim and (she can) dance. Qisqa javoblarda Yes, I do. / No, she isn't. deyiladi.

title: phrasal verbs 1: separable vs inseparable
rule_uz: Phrasal fe'l - fe'l va predlog yoki ravish birikmasi, ma'nosi ko'pincha alohida so'zlarning ma'nosidan farq qiladi. Ajraladigan fe'llarda to'ldiruvchi fe'l bilan zarracha orasiga kelishi mumkin: turn off the light yoki turn the light off. Agar to'ldiruvchi olmosh bo'lsa (it, them, me), u doim orada turadi: turn it off. Ajralmaydigan fe'llarda to'ldiruvchi hamisha oxirida keladi: look after the baby, look after her.

title: make vs do
rule_uz: Make odatda biror narsani yaratish, ishlab chiqarish yoki natija hosil qilish ma'nosida ishlatiladi: make a cake, make a mistake. Do esa ish, faoliyat va vazifa haqida: do homework, do the dishes, do exercise. Ko'p birikmalar yodlanadi: make a decision, make a phone call, make friends, make money, make noise; do your best, do a favour, do research, do housework, do business. Qaysi birikma qaysi fe'l bilan kelishini yodlash kerak.

do + homework / the dishes / a favour / your best / research

title: have / take / get collocations
rule_uz: Ingliz tilida ko'p so'z birikmalari have, take yoki get bilan tuziladi. Have: have breakfast, have a shower, have fun, have a look, have a rest, have a chat. Take: take a photo, take a break, take a bus, take an exam, take care, take a seat, take a bath. Get: get a letter, get angry, get better, get tired, get home, get a job. Bu fe'llar bu yerda o'z ma'nosini yo'qotib, birikmaning bir qismiga aylanadi.

title: the many meanings of get
rule_uz: Get juda ko'p ma'noga ega, ma'nosi keyingi so'zga qarab o'zgaradi. Get + ot: olmoq (get a present). Get + sifat: bo'lmoq (get cold, get angry). Get + joy: yetib bormoq (get to school, get home). Get + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi: ro'y bermoq (get lost, get married). Get + for / on / off kabi predloglar boshqa ma'nolar beradi: get on a bus - avtobusga chiqmoq, get off - tushmoq, get up - o'rnidan turmoq.
forms: get + noun = receive / buy (get a gift)
get + adjective = become (get dark, get tired)

title: word formation: nouns from verbs and adjectives
rule_uz: Ko'p otlar fe'l yoki sifatga qo'shimcha qo'shib yasaladi. Fe'ldan: -tion / -sion (decide - decision, invite - invitation), -ment (achieve - achievement), -er / -or (teach - teacher), -ance / -ence (appear - appearance). Sifatdan: -ness (happy - happiness), -ity (able - ability), -th (strong - strength), -dom (free - freedom). Imlo ba'zan o'zgaradi: happy - happiness. Yangi so'zni o'rganganda uning oilasini ham yozib qo'ying.

adjective + -ness / -ity: kind - kindness, able - ability

title: word formation: adjectives (suffixes and prefixes)
rule_uz: Sifatlar otdan yoki fe'ldan qo'shimchalar yordamida yasaladi. Ba'zida oxirgi harf tushib qoladi: fame - famous. Ma'nolar farqli: careful - ehtiyotkor, careless - beparvo.

noun + -y / -al / -ous: sun - sunny, danger - dangerous

title: word formation: negative prefixes
rule_uz: Sifat, fe'l va otlarning oldiga qo'shimcha qo'yib, ularning ma'nosini teskarisiga o'zgartirish mumkin. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigani un- (happy - unhappy, lock - unlock). In- (correct - incorrect) odatda lotin ildizli so'zlarda uchraydi; im- p, m, b harflaridan oldin (possible - impossible); il- l dan oldin (legal - illegal); ir- r dan oldin (regular - irregular). Dis- (agree - disagree, like - dislike) va mis- (understand - misunderstand) ham bor. Qaysi so'zga qaysi qo'shimcha ketishini yodlash kerak.
forms: un- + happy / lucky / usual / lock

Qo'shma otda birinchi so'z ikkinchisini tasvirlaydi (tennis ball), shuning uchun birinchisi odatda birlikda turadi: a shoe shop.

title: it / there structures (It seems that ..., There seems to be ...)
rule_uz: It seems that, it looks as if, it turns out that kabi tuzilmalar taxmin yoki xulosa bildiradi: It seems that he is late. There seems to be / There appears to be mavjudlik haqida taxmin qiladi: There seems to be a problem. Seem + to-infinitive ham mumkin: He seems to know the answer. Rasmiy bo'lmagan uslubda it is + sifat + to-infinitive ham keladi: It is difficult to learn Chinese. There ega bo'lib kelganda fe'l keyingi otga moslashadi: There seem to be two mistakes.

Would rather + asl fe'l (to'siz) ham xuddi shunday ma'noni beradi: I would rather stay at home. Taqqoslash uchun than ishlatiladi: I'd rather walk than take a bus. Had better + asl fe'l maslahat yoki ogohlantirish: You had better take an umbrella. Inkori: had better not.

title: certainty and possibility (definitely, probably, likely)
rule_uz: Kelajak haqida qanchalik ishonch borligini ravishlar va iboralar bilan bildiramiz. Definitely va certainly - 100% ishonch; probably - katta ehtimol; possibly va perhaps / maybe - kam ehtimol. Ular odatda will dan oldin, lekin won't dan keyin turadi: She will probably win; She definitely won't come. Be likely to + fe'l va It is likely that + gap ham ishlatiladi: He is likely to be late. Unlikely - ehtimoli kam: It is unlikely to snow.

title: discourse markers for speaking and writing
rule_uz: Discourse markers fikrlarni bir-biriga bog'laydi va tinglovchi yoki o'quvchiga nutqning yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi. Boshlash: first of all, to begin with. Qo'shish: besides, in addition, also. Suhbatda: by the way (aytgancha), anyway (baribir), actually (aslida), as I said. Yozma matnda ko'pincha vergul bilan ajratiladi.

title: formal vs informal register
rule_uz: Til vaziyatga qarab o'zgaradi. Do'stlar bilan norasmiy so'zlashamiz: qisqartmalar (I'm, don't), phrasal fe'llar (find out) va oddiy so'zlar (kids, ask for). Rasmiy muloqotda do not, I would like to, Could you possibly...? kabi shakllar kerak. Salomlashuv ham farq qiladi: Hi! - norasmiy, Dear Sir or Madam - rasmiy.

title: review: mixed grammar and error correction
title_uz: Takrorlash: aralash grammatika va xatolarni topish
rule_uz: Bu darsda siz o'rgangan mavzularni birga takrorlaymiz: zamonlar, shartli gaplar, majhul nisbat, modal fe'llar, predloglar va so'z yasalishi. Xatoni topishda gapni diqqat bilan o'qing va savollarni o'zingizga bering: zamon to'g'rimi? Fe'l egaga mosmi? Predlog to'g'rimi? Gerund yoki infinitiv kerakmi? Ko'p xatolar kichik so'zlarda bo'ladi: a / the, do / does, in / on. Javobingizni jim o'qib tekshiring.
forms: check tense and subject-verb agreement
check preposition after verb / adjective / noun
check gerund or infinitive after the verb
check word order, articles and word form

examples.en: If I had known about the test, I would have studied more.
examples.uz: Agar test haqida bilganimda, ko'proq tayyorlanardim.

examples.en: The homework must be handed in by Friday.
examples.uz: Uy vazifasi juma kunigacha topshirilishi kerak.

examples.en: She suggested going to the park after lunch.
examples.uz: U tushlikdan keyin parkka borishni taklif qildi.

mistakes.wrong: I look forward to see you soon.
mistakes.right: I look forward to seeing you soon.
mistakes.note_uz: Look forward to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He said me that he was tired.
mistakes.right: He told me that he was tired.
mistakes.note_uz: Said dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shaxs kelmaydi; tell + shaxs ishlatiladi.
